title: Cypress Exercises
description: Practise the ideas from this Cypress course. Each answer has an explanation to help you learn.

exercises.question: What page must exist locally?
exercises.explanation: Cypress runs browser checks as a chain of commands. This example starts with a blank local practice page. The test inserts and checks a Library heading on the local page.

exercises.question: Which attribute is used for this target?
exercises.explanation: A stable data attribute can identify a control without tying a test to its visual style. The selector finds the button by its testing attribute.

exercises.question: What should have.value check?
exercises.explanation: type enters text and clear removes existing text. A final value check confirms the input received it. The input contains Moon.

exercises.question: Which result is checked?
exercises.explanation: A click test needs an observable result. Here the button changes its own text. The click changes Save to Done.

exercises.question: What should a test wait for?
exercises.explanation: Cypress retries many queries and assertions until they pass or time out. Check a real condition instead of guessing a delay. The assertion waits for the visible Ready paragraph within its configured time limit.

exercises.question: Where is the yielded paragraph available?
options: As a plain return value immediately
exercises.explanation: then receives the value yielded by the previous command. This is how you inspect queued results. The callback receives the paragraph and checks its text.

exercises.question: Which action sets checked state?
exercises.explanation: check requests the checked state. It states intent more clearly than a toggle click. The box is checked.

exercises.question: What is the selected value?
exercises.explanation: select chooses a native option by value or text. Assert the stored value after the action. The Large option is selected.

exercises.question: How many items are checked?
exercises.explanation: A query can find several elements. have.length checks how many the query found. Two list items are found.

exercises.question: Who supplies the books response here?
exercises.explanation: intercept can supply a known network response. Set it up before the page sends the request. The intercepted request returns a test response with status 200. No book API service is required.

exercises.question: Where should needed state be prepared?
options: In the test or its setup
exercises.explanation: A test should set up the state it needs. Cypress test isolation helps avoid state leaking from a previous test. This test arranges its own theme value.

exercises.question: What should you do with a failed assertion?
options: Compare actual behaviour with the intended rule
exercises.explanation: A failed assertion tells you which expected condition was not met. Use the command log and screenshot to understand it. The test verifies the heading and records visible evidence.
